content: Game economy (cross-checked: GameGrowthAdvisor, Riseup Labs, Machinations, Yodo1 4S framework): taps (sources) vs sinks; health = balance between them. Inflation control tactics: exponentially rising upgrade costs, transaction taxes, rotating content, seasonal resets, cosmetic/prestige sinks. Scarcity types (energy caps) set pacing but players punish punishing energy walls - prefer async/time clocks over hard energy gates. Pinch point: resource scarce enough to matter, abundant enough to keep active. Critical for this project: the Tam Quoc game shares users.balance with the main TuTien economy, so its net currency flow must be sink-leaning (travel costs + items) with faucets kept small (starter, boss drops of ITEMS not currency) or it inflates the whole bot economy.
